parameters.formDescription: Fill this out once. It builds the WhatsApp post, the SMS version, the teaser, and the matched buyer list.

values.placeholder: Leave blank unless it's a named sub-market
New Roof plus Impact Windows and Doors and updated electrical panel
3 years old — leave blank if unknown
5 years old — leave blank if unknown
PVC plumbing throughout, impact windows and doors, updated electrical panel
NO HOA — or the monthly amount
One per line, e.g. Needs interior rehab to achieve highest ARV level
One per line: 1846 NW 49 ST, Miami, FL 33142 - Sold for $480,000 on 7/10/26
Optional. Anything the teaser writer should know that isn't captured above.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 8000, system: 'You write short outreach texts for Buying Hero, a South Florida wholesaler, to its cash-buyer list. Non-negotiable rules: (1) The teaser NEVER contains the street address - withholding it is what forces the reply. City is fine. (2) Never invent exclusivity, urgency, competing offers, deadlines, or any claim you were not given. (3) Never state a number you were not given. (4) Sound like a person texting a contact they know. Short sentences, no emoji, no ALL CAPS, no marketing voice.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Deal facts:
City: ' + $json.derivedCity + '
Beds/Baths: ' + $json.raw['Beds'] + '/' + $json.raw['Baths'] + '
Type: ' + $json.raw['Property Type'] + '
ARV: ' + $json.raw['ARV'] + '
Asking: ' + $json.raw['Asking Price'] + '
Headline feature: ' + $json.raw['Headline'] + '

Additional details from the dispo manager:
' + ($json.raw['Additional Details'] || '(none provided - work from the facts above)') + '

Write the teaser set.' }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { teaser_sms: { type: 'string', description: 'Under 320 characters. Beds/baths, city, ARV, price, one standout feature, soft CTA. NO street address. Use {{first_name}} for the buyer and Andrew as sender.' }, hook_used: { type: 'string', description: 'The opener line only, so it can be written to buy_last_hook and never reused on the same buyer.' }, email_subject: { type: 'string', description: 'Subject line for the email version.' }, voice_brief: { type: 'string', description: 'Plain fact sheet the voice AI answers from. Facts only, no script, no persuasion.' } }, required: ['teaser_sms','hook_used','email_subject','voice_brief'], additionalProperties: false } } } }) }}
